body: The class is Tuppu's WorkManager job; in logcat 'SyncWorker' reads like a system component. Rename the class, file, tests, Hilt worker binding and the log TAG to TuppuSyncWorker. WorkManager persists requests by class name: an upgraded phone still holds a periodic request naming the old class and would never run it again. So the periodic request must be re-enqueued with ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.UPDATE (or CANCEL_AND_REENQUEUE) once — check what SyncScheduler uses today and either switch the policy or bump the unique work name. Test: the scheduler's request names the new class; a Robolectric WorkManager test that an existing request under the old class name is replaced.
title: Android: rename SyncWorker to TuppuSyncWorker so its log lines read as the app's own, and replace the enqueued periodic job on upgrade
